questions.q: When would 3-way matching be the better choice over 2-way matching?
options: Never - 2-way matching is always sufficient
Only for services with no receipt step at all
3-way matching is only used in Receivables, not Payables
For a physical goods purchase, such as raw materials, where paying before actual receipt is a real risk
questions.explain: 3-way matching adds the receipt step, confirming goods were actually received - important for physical purchases where paying before receipt is risky.

questions.q: What specifically happens on AP aging when a GRNI accrual fails to auto-reverse?
options: Nothing - GRNI accruals have no effect on AP aging
The purchase order is automatically cancelled
The accrual sits on the books alongside the real invoice, so AP aging and the GL stop agreeing on what is owed
AutoInvoice stops working entirely
questions.explain: If the GRNI accrual doesn't reverse when the real invoice posts, both sit on the books together, causing AP aging and the GL control account to disagree.

questions.q: What is the correct response to an invoice held for a matching discrepancy?
options: Override the hold immediately so payment isn't delayed
Delete the invoice and ask the supplier to resend it
Investigate and resolve the actual discrepancy behind the hold before releasing it
Holds should always be ignored since they resolve themselves
questions.explain: Overriding a hold without resolving its cause just defers the same problem. The correct approach is to investigate and fix the actual discrepancy first.

questions.q: What is the most common reason AutoInvoice fails to create a real AR invoice from imported data?
options: AutoInvoice never fails under any circumstances
Missing or mismatched reference data, such as an invalid customer site or a transaction type without a mapped account
The customer's phone number is missing
The invoice amount is too small
questions.explain: AutoInvoice validates imported data against required setups. Missing or mismatched reference data - like an invalid customer site - is the most common failure point.

questions.q: A client says an AR aging report looks wrong. What is the recommended first step?
options: Assume the report itself is broken and rebuild it from scratch
Immediately reverse every receipt posted that month
Tell the client the report is correct without checking anything
Pull the transaction detail behind the summary and check the specific invoices and their receipt applications
questions.explain: Rather than assuming the report is wrong, the right first step is pulling the underlying detail to determine whether the issue is a timing difference or a genuine misapplication.
